name: thyroid hormone receptor alpha

function.text: THRA is the approved symbol for thyroid hormone receptor alpha. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in DNA-binding transcription factor activity; DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; cell differentiation.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include congenital nongoitrous hypothyroidism 6 (autosomal dominant). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Glioblastoma; Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Low-grade glioma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; Strong GenCC assertion, Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific review required.
